items.label: Repost Cooldown: rescan recent posts
items.description: Re-reads the subreddit's recent posts so reposts of them are caught.

items.label: Repost Cooldown: erase stored data
items.description: Erases everything the app has stored for this subreddit. Asks first.

cooldownDays.label: Cooldown (days)
cooldownDays.helpText: A repost or same-sub crosspost is removed if the original is newer than this and still up. A shorter cooldown applies at once; a longer one is only certain to cover posts made after the change. A cooldown longer than 30 days is fully applied only if the subreddit gets fewer than 1000 posts in that time; a busier one gets at least 30 days.

checkRemovedPosts.label: Also remove reposts of posts that a moderator removed
checkRemovedPosts.helpText: Off unless you switch it on. When on: a post that a moderator removes by hand still counts as an original, so posting it again is removed. That lasts until the post's cooldown ends, for 30 days at most, and ends sooner if a moderator approves the post or its author deletes it. Removals by AutoModerator, Reddit and other apps never count.

ignoredRemovers.label: Moderator accounts whose removals are not counted
ignoredRemovers.helpText: Only used when the option above is on. Usernames separated by commas, for bots that run under an ordinary account. AutoModerator and other apps are never counted, so they do not need to be listed.

checkCrossposts.label: Remove crossposts of posts from this subreddit

checkLinks.label: Remove posts that share a link with a recent post

maxTextLinks.label: Compare links inside a post's text when it has at most this many
maxTextLinks.helpText: A post with more links than this is treated as a roundup and its links are not compared. Set to 0 to ignore links inside text.

checkTitles.label: Remove posts that share a title with a recent post
checkTitles.helpText: Applies to posts without text, such as images, videos and links. A post with text is only removed when its text matches too.

minTitleLength.label: Shortest title to compare (letters and digits)
minTitleLength.helpText: Titles shorter than this, such as "Help" or "Question", are never treated as reposts. Set to 0 to compare every title.

checkText.label: Remove text posts that repeat the text of a recent post

minTextLength.label: Shortest text to compare (letters and digits)
minTextLength.helpText: Post text shorter than this is never treated as a repost. Set to 0 to compare every text.

exemptModerators.label: Never remove posts made by moderators

leaveComment.label: Leave a stickied comment explaining the removal

removalMessage.label: Removal comment
removalMessage.defaultValue:
Hi u/{author}, your post was removed because {reason}: [the earlier post]({original}), made {age}.

In r/{subreddit} the same post can be shared again once {cooldown} days have passed since the original.

*I am a bot. If you think this was a mistake, please [message the moderators](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=r/{subreddit}).*

removedOriginalMessage.label: Removal comment when the original was removed by a moderator
removedOriginalMessage.helpText: Only used when that option is on, instead of the comment above. The same placeholders work.
removedOriginalMessage.defaultValue:
Hi u/{author}, your post was removed because it repeats [an earlier post]({original}) that the moderators of r/{subreddit} removed.

Please do not post it again.

*I am a bot. If you think this was a mistake, please [message the moderators](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=r/{subreddit}).*
